interaction.speaker: Ms. Mara - Zoo Educator
interaction.text: Welcome to the Friendly Zoo! Here you will learn which animals are domestic and can live with us, and which are wild and must stay in nature. Domestic animals are gentle and used to people. Wild animals need space and are dangerous to touch!

interaction.content:
WILD vs DOMESTIC:

WILD (do NOT touch, observe from far): Bear, Fox, Wolf, Lion - they live in forests and need freedom.

DOMESTIC (gentle, live with humans): Dog, Cat, Chicken, Sheep, Rabbit, Horse - they need our care.

Rule: Never approach, feed or pet a wild animal! Always ask an adult before petting a domestic animal.
interaction.title: Zoo Safety Rules

interaction.title: Zoo Map

interaction.content: DOMESTIC ANIMALS: Cat meows, Dog barks - they love people, need food/water/shelter from us. You can pet them gently when adult says ok, wash hands after!
interaction.title: Domestic Animals - Our Friends

interaction.content: WILD ANIMALS: Bear and Fox live in forests. They hunt and are afraid of people. Never touch, never feed, stay behind fences and stay quiet. If you see one in nature, tell an adult and walk away slowly.
interaction.title: Wild Animals - Observe Only
